The play targets 448 consent-filtered customers across six high-affinity segments. The expected outcome is to sell 43.12 units, recovering INR 2078.82 versus doing nothing and beating a blanket markdown by INR 408.44. This bundle satisfies the 8.00% bakery margin floor with an expected net margin of 8.78%.
